additive_json_fields.presence: optional existing OSNMF declaration identity on checked failure, never body attestation or authority
optional checked root/projections; null when unknown
optional actual root binding name; null when unknown
optional conflicting ledger entry; null when unknown
optional advisory classes, never applied or presumed verified edits
optional static effect requirement, never a runtime grant
optional exact replacement proposals; never autoapplied

new_syntax: impl alias.Trait for LocalType { ... } (trait of an imported module; orphan rule)
packed struct Name { ... } (alignment 1, no padding; Wave21/OMC21)
thread_local NAME Type = literal (integer types; private to its module; Wave21/OMC21; baremetal-x86_64 only)
struct Name<T, U: Constraint> { ... } (generic struct declaration)
Name<A, B> (type use) and Name<A, B> { field: value } (initializer)
enum Name<T, U: Constraint> { A(T), B(U), C } and Name.A<args>(payload) (constructor)
trait Name { func m(x Self) R !caps } (method signatures), impl Name for T { func m(..) .. { .. } } (bodies), Name.m<T>(args) (static-dispatch call)
expr? (postfix Result/Option propagation, lowered before checking)
move(r) of a struct that owns Resources (rewritten to field moves)
opaque struct Name { ... } (literal and fields only inside its module; Wave21/OMC21)
extern struct Name { ... } (C layout contract: integers and plain structs, natural C alignment, reached through an explicit address; Wave21/OMC21)
const NAME Type = literal | array(literals) | pure scalar expression (a pure function without parameters, evaluated when validated)
static_assert(condition, "message") (module item; decided by the checker with the evaluator; leaves no trace in the program)

export "sym" | extern "sym" | section ".name" | noinline before func (link-time identity; C ABI v1: SysV integers, up to 6 parameters; extern needs ffi.call; Wave21/OMC21 linkage form and LNK1 trailer)

origin_core_pro_x64_conformance.conformance: tests/x64 (Core-owned minimal provider, test-owned boot adapter, programs) exercised by A83X64* classes

isa_modes.gpr: default: general-purpose registers only; f32/f64 and the FP-state primitives are rejected with E_TARGET_PROFILE
isa_modes.sse2: floating point allowed; arithmetic lowered to LLVM constrained intrinsics (round.dynamic, fpexcept.strict) in strictfp functions

not_claimed: PT_TLS / dynamic TLS / destructors / non-integer or exported thread-locals / typed per-CPU variables

trap_codes_added.12: extended-state fault (misaligned/null FXSAVE area, reserved MXCSR bits)
trap_codes_added.13: thread/CPU block fault (unset base, bad magic, offset inside the 16-byte header, past the block size, or wrapping)
trap_codes_added.14: typed raw access to a native record: misaligned or null address

builtin_families_added: cpu.* privileged operations (cpuid, rdtsc, rdmsr, wrmsr, lgdt, lidt, ltr, cli, sti, halt, read/write_cr, switch_context, enter/leave_ring3, ...)
general_hardware_primitives.nominal_resources: Resource<R>/Borrow<R>/BorrowMut<R> for a declared struct R with one u64 field; must be consumed (E_RESOURCE_UNCONSUMED), no automatic cleanup; immutable records recursively preserve the same typed consumption entry at each nominal field (NOMINAL_AFFINE_RESOURCE_CANDIDATE.md, CP-01 amendment). Admitted Option/enum payloads transfer the record's leaf obligations, never duplicate them.

relaxed_rejections: Borrow/BorrowMut function result when tied to exactly one borrowed parameter (BORROW_RETURN_REGIONS_CANDIDATE.md)
Option<Resource<T>> as a linear match-consumed value (OPTION_RESOURCE_CANDIDATE.md)
Option<Record> with recursive Resource leaves as a pending value; Some transfers projected ownership and structured cleanup (OPTION_RESOURCE_CANDIDATE.md, owning record amendment); CP-01 remains open
Nested pending Option/Result/enum payloads use the same consumption ledger recursively, including Result with Copy alternatives (OWNERSHIP_COMPOSITION_CANDIDATE.md, nested pending sums amendment)

Immutable records may own pending fields under the existing typed projected obligations; Copy classification follows pending obligations even without Resource leaves. Array ownership is covered by the owning Array amendment (PRODUCT_TYPES_LAYOUT_0_2.md)
generic struct declarations (GENERIC_STRUCT_CANDIDATE.md); generic enum declarations (same spec)

Immutable owning Tuple elements use the same typed projected obligations as records, including whole moves, literal-index loans and named destructuring; Borrow/async/View element restrictions remain (PRODUCT_TYPES_LAYOUT_0_2.md, Core 1.3 amendment)

Immutable owning Array<T,N> with 1 <= N <= 16: literal-index element Places (loans, moves, pending transfer), whole-array move, per-element cleanup; dynamic index, array.fill, array.with, view and for-in over an owning Array are rejected (new diagnostic E_ARRAY_OWNING_INDEX; PRODUCT_TYPES_LAYOUT_0_2.md, owning Array amendment). Dynamic collections of resources remain CP-04/CP-05

representations.onme_writer: ONME2 when current executable/authoring roots equal the historical projections; ONME3 otherwise (complete function identities, envelope domain /3). ONME2 reader checks current semantics and the historical root algorithm; active OSNMF always uses complete identities. OSM2/OSMI2 unchanged.
representations.hardware_primitives_fence: DECIDED (spec/HARDWARE_REPRESENTATION_FENCE_CANDIDATE.md): raw./port./cpu./atomic./tls./pcpu. calls, the nominal-resource builtins and types, and the machine capabilities share the Wave21/OMC21 fence (no new version number, no new grammar). Measured before: such programs were written as Wire 18 and a core-v1.2.1.0 reader rejected them only with E_CAPABILITY.
representations.manifest_and_receipt_version: wire_profile and wave_writer of omni manifest and of the build receipt are the version the writer emits (OMC18..OMC22), taken from the function the writers use; before, every program above Wave20 was reported as OMC18.
representations.onme3_for_new_identities: A program the certified compilers could not project (an identity left unresolved in the signature of a generic template) is written as ONME3. The signature of a generic template has a module-qualified identity in the current projection; the Onme2Compatibility projection keeps the historical algorithm, and ONME2 files written by the certified compiler still verify.

limits_scope.count_and_size_limits: none: modules, functions, structs, enums, fields, variants, parameters, arguments, match arms, traits, impls, static_assert, thread_local, tokens, nodes and the bytes of a source file, a project or a representation are bounded by the memory budget (E_BUDGET), not by a count (Adenda 015E)
limits_scope.memory_budget: OMNI_MEMORY_MIB=n is an exact ceiling on the heap counted by the allocator (0 or unlimited removes it); by default the mode is automatic: no ceiling of the compiler, and the allocator refuses what the host reports it cannot provide (MemAvailable bounded by the cgroup and by an address-space limit of the caller). A reserve for other tenants of the host is the policy of whoever starts the compiler
limits_scope.stack_budget: OMNI_STACK_KIB (256 MiB by default, 256 KiB to 4 GiB); a chain of imports stops before the guard page with E_BUDGET
limits_scope.representation_width: an enum has at most 256 variants: its tag is one byte (i8)
limits_scope.structural_depths: nesting of types (8), blocks (32), height of an expression (64), parentheses (192) and aggregates in a layout (16): provisional, registered as a blocker until they are derived from the stack budget
limits_scope.runtime_contract: Text and Bytes values, host.read, host grants and the captured output of a run are at most 1 MiB

representations.writer_rule: Wave21/OMC21 minimum for returned Borrow/BorrowMut, bit.*, owning Options or nested pending sum composition, a pending enum declaration, owning Tuple and Array declarations/signatures/expressions, a record declaration with nominal Resource or pending fields, machine primitives/capabilities, packed records, opaque records, function linkage attributes (export/extern/section/noinline) or thread_local; otherwise 18/19/20 unchanged. Wave22/OMC22 authoring capsules retain their existing precedence.

status_scope: Current WIP implementation delta; not release certification. Historical design revision is independent of product identity.

tooling.target_context: actual compiler target facts, canonical layouts, capability registry and complete shipped normative intrinsic/profile contracts; no execution or authority grant
tooling.component_descriptor: one checked program, per-module OSNMF identities, functions/templates/types/ownership/effects/linkage/ABI/profile constraints; unavailable layouts explicit and no granted capabilities
tooling.lsp: real workspace snapshots, Unicode-to-UTF-16 ranges, checked function/local bindings, versioned rename proposals rechecked for capture; unsupported or incomplete mappings reject; full-content synchronization rejects stale or ranged changes
tooling.admission: omni admit FILE: static YES/NO through the ordinary checker; no execution, grants, persistent edits or artifacts
tooling.diagnostic_coordinates: primary/related Particle byte positions rendered as Unicode scalar columns; decoded representation positions without original-source mapping use null spans
tooling.fixits: optional exact replacement proposals in diagnostic JSON and versioned LSP quick fixes; never autoapplied
